title: The Grateful Magpie
moral: Remember kindness and give it back.
notes: 영어 읽어 주기 대본(docs/READ_MODE.md). text 는 한국어 줄(키), en 이 읽는 문장. src=reuse 는 narration_el_en.js 의 영어 녹음 그대로, trim 은 from 줄의 영어 녹음을 같은 문장 경계에서 자른 것, new 만 새로 녹음한다. 배역·연기 지시는 read_script_el.json 의 같은 줄을 따른다.

acts.set:<mg_bg_path|mg_bg_bigtree|mg_bg_nest: 장면 배경(scene(key)). scenes[].set 으로 자동 호출, 장면 안에서 배경을 바꿀 때는 before 에 둔다
acts.snake:look:<coil|flee>[:<dir>] | snake:a: 구렁이. climb = 기둥 밑으로 간 뒤 나무 위로 기어오름(놀이판 2장), flee = 오른쪽으로 스르르 달아나 숨음
acts.parents:land: 놀이판 2장 끝: 엄마·아빠가 나무에서 선비 옆 땅으로 내려와 앉음
acts.parents:collapse: 놀이판 7장 끝: 엄마·아빠 tired 자세로 종 아래에 스르르 내려앉음(fadeIn + move + paper_down)
acts.chicks:nest | chicks:hop | chicks:hide: 아기 까치 N 마리를 배경 둥지의 오목한 자리에 앉힘(놀이판 3장 spotX/spotY, 짹! 팝 포함). 새끼는 둥지 안에서만 보인다
acts.flock:fly | flock:hide: 엄마·아빠·친구 까치 3마리가 왼쪽에서 오른쪽 밤하늘로 날아감(놀이판 6장)
acts.arrow:shoot: 선비 draw → wiggle → release, 화살이 구렁이 옆 나무로 날아가 탁!(놀이판 2장 연출 그대로)
acts.bell:show | bell:strike:<1|2|3> | bell:f: 범종 놓기 / 놀이판 strike(k): 아빠(1)·엄마(2)·둘(3)이 머리로 종을 치고 댕— / far = 새벽 장면의 멀리서 들리는 종소리 3번(여인이 흠칫)
acts.water:drops: 선비가 까치에게 물을 먹이는 물방울 4개와 똑똑! 팝(놀이판 9장)
acts.cut:<arrow|flee|flock|ring|wake>: 만화 컷 mg_cut_* (컷 안 외침 없음)

lines.text: 옛날 옛날, 마음씨 고운 선비가 과거를 보러 먼 길을 떠났어요.
lines.en: Once upon a time, a kind young scholar set off on a long journey to take the royal exam.
segs: Once upon a time, a kind young scholar set off on a long journey to take the royal exam.

lines.text: 봄 햇살이 따뜻하고, 길가에는 들꽃이 활짝활짝 피어 있었어요.
lines.en: The spring sun was warm, and wildflowers bloomed wide, wide open along the path.
segs: The spring sun was warm, and wildflowers bloomed wide, wide open along the path.

lines.text: 저벅저벅. 산 넘고 물 건너, 선비는 깊은 산속으로 들어갔어요.
lines.en: Step, step. Over hills and across streams, the scholar walked deep into the mountains.
segs: Step, step. Over hills and across streams, the scholar walked deep into the mountains.

lines.text: 나무가 빽빽해지고, 짹짹 새소리가 점점 가까워졌어요.
lines.en: The trees grew thick, and the tweet-tweet of birds came closer and closer.
segs: The trees grew thick, and the tweet-tweet of birds came closer and closer.

lines.text: 그때 어디선가 까악까악, 다급한 까치 소리가 들렸어요.
lines.en: Then, from somewhere, came a frantic caw-caw, the cry of a magpie.
segs: Then, from somewhere, came a frantic caw-caw, the cry of a magpie.

lines.text: 선비가 소리를 따라 큰 소나무 아래로 달려갔어요.
lines.en: The scholar followed the cries and ran to a big pine tree.
segs: The scholar followed the cries and ran to a big pine tree.

lines.text: 둥지 위에서 엄마 까치가 다급하게 외쳤어요.
lines.en: Up at the nest, Mother Magpie called out in a hurry.
segs: Up at the nest, Mother Magpie called out in a hurry.

lines.text: 까악, 까악! 도와주세요!
lines.en: Caw, caw! Please help us!

lines.text: 큰 소나무 위 둥지에 아기 까치들이 있어요. 그런데 구렁이가 스르르 올라가고 있어요!
lines.en: High in the big pine tree was a nest of baby magpies. And a big snake was slithering up toward it!
segs: High in the big pine tree was a nest of baby magpies. And a big snake was slithering up toward it!

lines.text: 엄마 까치는 둥지를 지키고, 아빠 까치는 둥지 둘레를 빙빙 돌며 울었어요.
lines.en: Mama Magpie guarded the nest, while Papa Magpie circled round and round it, crying out.
segs: Mama Magpie guarded the nest, while Papa Magpie circled round and round it, crying out.

lines.text: 안 돼! 내가 아기 까치들을 지켜 줄게.
lines.en: Oh no! I will keep the baby magpies safe.
segs: Oh no! I will keep the baby magpies safe.

lines.text: 선비가 활을 꺼냈어요.
lines.from: 선비가 활을 꺼냈어요. 선비를 톡 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: The scholar took out his bow.
segs: The scholar took out his bow.

lines.text: 선비는 후우 숨을 고르고, 활시위를 팽팽 당겼어요.
lines.en: The scholar took a deep breath, whoo, and pulled the bowstring back, tight, tight.
segs: The scholar took a deep breath, whoo, and pulled the bowstring back, tight, tight.

lines.text: 쉬익, 탁! 화살이 구렁이 바로 옆 나무에 꽂혔어요.
lines.en: Whoosh, thunk! The arrow struck the tree right beside the snake.
segs: Whoosh, thunk! The arrow struck the tree right beside the snake.

lines.text: 깜짝 놀란 구렁이는 스르르 숲으로 달아났어요.
lines.en: The startled snake slithered away into the forest.
segs: The startled snake slithered away into the forest.

lines.text: 선비는 활을 내려놓고, 후유 하고 긴 숨을 쉬었어요.
lines.en: The scholar lowered his bow and let out a long, deep breath.
segs: The scholar lowered his bow and let out a long, deep breath.

lines.text: 안심한 까치 부부가 선비에게 말했어요.
lines.en: Feeling safe, the two magpies spoke to the scholar.
segs: Feeling safe, the two magpies spoke to the scholar.

lines.text: 고맙습니다, 선비님! 이 은혜는 꼭 갚을게요.
lines.en: Thank you, kind scholar! We will repay your kindness, we promise.
segs: We will repay your kindness, we promise.

lines.text: 까치 부부는 포르르 날아 내려와 고개를 꾸벅 숙였어요.
lines.en: The magpie couple fluttered down, flap-flap, and bowed their heads low.
segs: The magpie couple fluttered down, flap-flap, and bowed their heads low.

lines.text: 선비가 떠나기 전, 소나무 위 둥지를 올려다봤어요.
lines.en: Before leaving, the scholar looked up at the nest in the pine tree.
segs: Before leaving, the scholar looked up at the nest in the pine tree.

lines.text: 둥지 안에서 아기 까치들이 고개를 쏙 내밀었어요.
lines.en: The baby magpies popped their heads up out of the nest.
segs: The baby magpies popped their heads up out of the nest.

lines.text: 노란 부리를 벌리고, 아기 까치들이 짹짹 노래했어요.
lines.en: The baby magpies opened their little yellow beaks and sang, chirp, chirp.
segs: The baby magpies opened their little yellow beaks and sang, chirp, chirp.

lines.text: 짹짹! 선비님, 고맙습니다!
lines.en: Chirp chirp! Thank you, scholar!

lines.text: 엄마 까치는 아기들을 날개로 폭 감싸 주었어요.
lines.en: Mama Magpie wrapped her babies snugly under her wings.
segs: Mama Magpie wrapped her babies snugly under her wings.

lines.text: 선비는 아기 까치들을 보며 빙그레 웃었어요.
lines.en: The scholar looked at the baby magpies and smiled a gentle smile.
segs: The scholar looked at the baby magpies and smiled a gentle smile.

lines.text: 선비는 빙긋 웃으며 다시 길을 떠났어요.
lines.en: The scholar smiled and went on his way.
segs: The scholar smiled and went on his way.

lines.text: 선비는 저벅저벅 걸어가고, 까치 가족은 오래오래 바라보았어요.
lines.en: Step, step, the scholar walked away, and the magpie family watched him for a long, long time.
segs: Step, step, the scholar walked away, and the magpie family watched him for a long, long time.

lines.text: 어느새 해가 지고, 산길은 캄캄해졌어요.
lines.en: Soon the sun went down, and the mountain path grew dark.
segs: Soon the sun went down, and the mountain path grew dark.

lines.text: 바람이 쏴아 불고, 나뭇잎이 바스락바스락, 선비는 조금 무서웠어요.
lines.en: The wind went whoosh, the leaves went rustle-rustle, and the scholar felt a little bit scared.
segs: The wind went whoosh, the leaves went rustle-rustle, and the scholar felt a little bit scared.

lines.text: 오늘 밤은 어디서 자지? …어, 저기 불빛이!
lines.en: Where will I sleep tonight? ...Oh, a light over there!
segs: Where will I sleep tonight? ...Oh, a light over there!

lines.text: 선비는 불빛을 따라 외딴집 앞에 도착했어요.
lines.en: Following the light, the scholar reached a lonely house.
segs: Following the light, the scholar reached a lonely house.

lines.text: 깊은 산속 외딴집에서 한 여인이 나왔어요.
lines.en: A woman came out of a lonely house deep in the mountains.
segs: A woman came out of a lonely house deep in the mountains.

lines.text: 어서 오세요, 나그네님. 하룻밤 쉬어 가세요.
lines.en: Welcome, traveler. Come in and rest for the night.
segs: Welcome, traveler. Come in and rest for the night.

lines.text: 고맙습니다. 하룻밤만 신세 질게요.
lines.en: Thank you. Just for one night, if I may.
segs: Thank you. Just for one night, if I may.

lines.text: 선비는 따뜻한 방에서 금세 잠이 들었어요.
lines.en: In the warm room, the scholar soon fell asleep.
segs: In the warm room, the scholar soon fell asleep.

lines.text: 꿈속에서도 아기 까치들이 짹짹 웃고 있었지요.
lines.en: Even in his dreams, the baby magpies were chirping and laughing.
segs: Even in his dreams, the baby magpies were chirping and laughing.

lines.text: 한밤중, 선비는 으스스한 기운에 눈을 떴어요.
lines.en: In the middle of the night, the scholar woke with a shiver.
segs: In the middle of the night, the scholar woke with a shiver.

lines.text: 방 안은 조용하고, 창호문 너머로 달빛만 어른어른 비쳤어요.
lines.en: The room was silent, and only the moonlight flickered, soft and faint, through the paper door.
segs: The room was silent, and only the moonlight flickered, soft and faint, through the paper door.

lines.text: 문 앞에 그 여인이 서 있었어요. 그런데… 치마 밑으로 꼬리가 삐죽!
lines.en: The woman was standing by the door. But... a tail was peeking out from under her skirt!
segs: The woman was standing by the door. But... a tail was peeking out from under her skirt!

lines.text: 나는 낮에 네가 활로 쫓아낸, 그 구렁이의 아내다.
lines.en: I am the wife of the snake you chased away with your arrow today.
segs: I am the wife of the snake you chased away with your arrow today.

lines.text: 내 남편을 놀라게 한 벌로, 너를 이대로 보내 줄 수는 없어.
lines.en: You frightened my husband. I cannot let you go just like that.
segs: You frightened my husband. I cannot let you go just like that.

lines.text: 저는 그저 아기 까치들을 지키려 했을 뿐이에요. 제발 보내 주세요.
lines.en: I only wanted to protect the baby magpies. Please, let me go.
segs: I only wanted to protect the baby magpies. Please, let me go.

lines.text: 좋아. 새벽이 오기 전에 저 산 위 절의 종이 세 번 울리면, 너를 놓아주마.
lines.en: Very well. If the temple bell on the mountain rings three times before dawn, I will let you go.
segs: Very well. If the temple bell on the mountain rings three times before dawn, I will let you go.

lines.text: 하지만 이 깊은 밤에, 누가 종을 치겠니? 후후…
lines.en: But in the deep of night, who would ring the bell? Hmm hmm...
segs: But in the deep of night, who would ring the bell? Hmm hmm...

lines.text: 종소리… 종이 울려야 해. 어떡하지…
lines.en: The bell... the bell has to ring. What can I do...
segs: The bell... the bell has to ring. What can I do...

lines.text: 선비는 무릎을 끌어안고 덜덜 떨며, 캄캄한 창밖만 바라보았어요.
lines.en: The scholar hugged his knees, shivering, brr, and stared out at the pitch-dark night.
segs: The scholar hugged his knees, shivering, brr, and stared out at the pitch-dark night.

lines.text: 선비가 갇힌 그 밤, 소나무 둥지로 가 볼까요?
lines.en: That same night, shall we visit the nest in the pine tree?
segs: That same night, shall we visit the nest in the pine tree?

lines.text: 그때, 큰 소나무 둥지의 까치 가족은 잠들지 못하고 있었어요.
lines.en: Meanwhile, in the nest in the big pine tree, the magpie family could not sleep.
segs: Meanwhile, in the nest in the big pine tree, the magpie family could not sleep.

lines.text: 여보, 선비님이 큰일 났어요! 외딴집의 구렁이 아내가…
lines.en: Dear, the scholar is in danger! The snake's wife at the lonely house...
segs: Dear, the scholar is in danger! The snake's wife at the lonely house...

lines.text: 종! 절의 종을 울리면 돼요. 우리가 날아가요!
lines.en: The bell! We just have to ring the temple bell. Let's fly!
segs: The bell! We just have to ring the temple bell. Let's fly!

lines.text: 아기들아, 둥지에서 꼭 기다리렴.
lines.en: Little ones, wait right here in the nest.
segs: Little ones, wait right here in the nest.

lines.text: 아기 까치들은 둥지 안에서 몸을 꼭 붙이고 고개를 끄덕끄덕했어요.
lines.en: The baby magpies snuggled close together in the nest and nodded, nod-nod, their little heads.
segs: The baby magpies snuggled close together in the nest and nodded, nod-nod, their little heads.

lines.text: 까치 엄마 아빠와 숲속 까치 친구들이 밤하늘로 날아올랐어요.
lines.en: Mama and Papa Magpie and their magpie friends rose into the night sky.
segs: Mama and Papa Magpie and their magpie friends rose into the night sky.

lines.text: 달님이 까치들의 길을 환하게 비추고, 별들이 반짝반짝 빛났어요.
lines.en: The moon lit the way for the magpies, and the stars went twinkle, twinkle.
segs: The moon lit the way for the magpies, and the stars went twinkle, twinkle.

lines.text: 달빛을 가르며, 산 위 절을 향해 쌩쌩!
lines.en: Through the moonlight, swish, swish, toward the temple on the mountain!
segs: Through the moonlight, swish, swish, toward the temple on the mountain!

lines.text: 절은 고요했어요. 커다란 종이 달빛 아래 걸려 있었어요.
lines.en: The temple was silent. A great bell hung in the moonlight.
segs: The temple was silent. A great bell hung in the moonlight.

lines.text: 종 앞에 도착한 아빠 까치가 말했어요.
lines.en: At the bell, Father Magpie spoke.
segs: At the bell, Father Magpie spoke.

lines.text: 종을 쳐야 해. 우리 머리로, 온 힘을 다해!
lines.en: We must strike the bell. With our heads, with all our might!
segs: We must strike the bell. With our heads, with all our might!

lines.text: 엄마 까치와 아빠 까치는 서로를 바라보고, 날개를 활짝 펴고 푸드덕 날았어요.
lines.en: Mama and Papa Magpie looked at each other, spread their wings wide, and flew, flap-flap!
segs: Mama and Papa Magpie looked at each other, spread their wings wide, and flew, flap-flap!

lines.text: 까치들이 머리로 종을 힘껏 쳤어요.
lines.en: The magpies struck the bell hard with their heads.
segs: The magpies struck the bell hard with their heads.

lines.text: 댕—. 깊고 큰 종소리가 산을 넘어 퍼져 갔어요.
lines.en: Dong... The deep, great sound of the bell rolled over the mountains.
segs: Dong... The deep, great sound of the bell rolled over the mountains.

lines.text: 댕—. 두 번째 종소리.
lines.en: Dong... The second ring.

lines.text: 댕—. 세 번째 종소리가 울렸어요.
lines.en: Dong... The third ring sounded.

lines.text: 까치들은 온 힘을 다해 종을 울렸어요.
lines.en: The magpies had rung the bell with all their might.
segs: The magpies had rung the bell with all their might.

lines.text: 그리고 힘이 다 빠진 까치들은, 종 아래에 스르르 쓰러져 잠이 들었어요.
lines.en: And then, with no strength left, the magpies sank down beneath the bell and fell asleep.
segs: And then, with no strength left, the magpies sank down beneath the bell and fell asleep.

lines.text: 달빛이 새근새근 잠든 까치들을 포근히 감싸 주었어요.
lines.en: The moonlight wrapped the magpies, sleeping softly, in its gentle glow.
segs: The moonlight wrapped the magpies, sleeping softly, in its gentle glow.

lines.text: 까치들이 종을 울리는 동안, 선비는 외딴집 방 안에 있었어요.
lines.en: While the magpies rang the bell, the scholar was in the lonely house.
segs: While the magpies rang the bell, the scholar was in the lonely house.

lines.text: 멀리서 종소리가 들려왔어요.
lines.en: From far away came the sound of the bell.
segs: From far away came the sound of the bell.

lines.text: 종이… 울렸어. 하나, 둘, 셋.
lines.en: The bell... it rang. One, two, three.
segs: The bell... it rang. One, two, three.

lines.text: 여인은 후우 한숨을 쉬었고, 목소리가 조금 부드러워졌어요.
lines.en: The woman let out a long sigh, whoo, and her voice grew just a little softer.
segs: The woman let out a long sigh, whoo, and her voice grew just a little softer.

lines.text: 약속은 약속. 너를 놓아주마.
lines.en: A promise is a promise. I will let you go.
segs: A promise is a promise. I will let you go.

lines.text: 여인은 스르르 구렁이로 변하더니, 새벽 숲으로 사라졌어요.
lines.en: The woman turned back into a snake and slipped away into the dawn forest.
segs: The woman turned back into a snake and slipped away into the dawn forest.

lines.text: 창밖이 조금씩 환해지고, 새들이 짹짹 지저귀기 시작했어요.
lines.en: Outside, the sky slowly grew light, and the birds began to sing, tweet-tweet.
segs: Outside, the sky slowly grew light, and the birds began to sing, tweet-tweet.

lines.text: 종소리… 누가 종을 울렸을까? 가 봐야겠어!
lines.en: The bell... who could have rung it? I must go and see!
segs: The bell... who could have rung it? I must go and see!

lines.text: 선비는 산 위 절로 달려갔어요.
lines.en: The scholar ran up to the temple on the mountain.
segs: The scholar ran up to the temple on the mountain.

lines.text: 절에 도착한 선비가 종 아래로 다가갔어요.
lines.en: At the temple, the scholar went up to the bell.
segs: At the temple, the scholar went up to the bell.

lines.text: 종 아래에, 까치 엄마 아빠가 눈을 감은 채 누워 있었어요.
lines.en: Beneath the bell, Mama and Papa Magpie lay with their eyes closed.
segs: Beneath the bell, Mama and Papa Magpie lay with their eyes closed.

lines.text: 선비는 숨이 턱 막혀, 그 자리에 우뚝 멈춰 섰어요.
lines.en: The scholar's breath caught in his throat, and he stopped right where he stood.
segs: The scholar's breath caught in his throat, and he stopped right where he stood.

lines.text: 까치야… 너희였구나. 나를 구하려고…
lines.en: Magpies... it was you. You did this to save me...
segs: Magpies... it was you. You did this to save me...

lines.text: 선비는 까치들을 품에 안고, 시원한 물을 한 모금씩 먹여 주었어요.
lines.en: The scholar held the magpies gently and gave them each a sip of cool water.
segs: The scholar held the magpies gently and gave them each a sip of cool water.

lines.text: 까치들의 날개가 파르르 떨리더니, 살며시 눈을 떴어요.
lines.en: The magpies' wings gave a little flutter, and slowly, they opened their eyes.
segs: The magpies' wings gave a little flutter, and slowly, they opened their eyes.

lines.text: 절의 종 아래에서 엄마 까치가 선비를 올려다보았어요.
lines.en: Below the temple bell, Mother Magpie looked up at the scholar.
segs: Below the temple bell, Mother Magpie looked up at the scholar.

lines.text: 선비님… 무사하셨군요.
lines.en: Scholar... you are safe.

lines.text: 은혜를 갚았으니, 이제 됐어요.
lines.en: We have repaid your kindness. That is enough.
segs: We have repaid your kindness. That is enough.

lines.text: "너희가 무사해서 정말 다행이야."
lines.en: I am so glad that you are both safe.
segs: I am so glad that you are both safe.

lines.text: 그때 아기 까치들이 짹짹 울며 날아왔어요.
lines.en: Just then, the baby magpies came flying, chirping all the way.
segs: Just then, the baby magpies came flying, chirping all the way.

lines.text: 엄마! 아빠!
lines.en: Mama! Papa!

lines.text: 선비는 까치 가족을 보며 하하 환하게 웃었어요.
lines.en: The scholar looked at the magpie family and laughed, ha-ha, with a big, bright smile.
segs: The scholar looked at the magpie family and laughed, ha-ha, with a big, bright smile.

lines.text: 고마워, 까치들아. 너희 마음, 평생 잊지 않을게.
lines.en: Thank you, magpies. I will never forget what you did for me.
segs: Thank you, magpies. I will never forget what you did for me.

lines.text: 은혜를 잊지 않고 갚는 마음은, 이렇게 따뜻해요.
lines.en: A heart that remembers kindness and gives it back is as warm as this.
segs: A heart that remembers kindness and gives it back is as warm as this.
